[[File:Peragus_miner_uniform.jpg|thumb|100px|[[Peragus Mining Facility]] standard miner's uniform, circa [[3951 BBY]]]]
A '''miner's uniform''' was the standard garment worn by [[Mining/Legends|mining]] personnel at the [[Peragus Mining Facility]]. The uniform provided very little in the way of protection, nonetheless, it was the only article of clothing available to the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] during the [[Skirmish at Peragus II]].
